page.title: Industry research
page.subtitle: Industry facts are aggregated from members' primary filings (aggregate method); every number opens its source drawer and replays from its manifest.

stale.title: Stale data
stale.body: Expected weekly; past the 2-day grace. The page keeps showing the latest active run (facts as of {date}); each cell's drawer names the run time.

error.title: Read failed
error.body: Showing the last good response ({at} UTC). Missing values are never shown as 0.
error.bodyNoCache: Nothing to show yet; try again shortly. Missing values are never shown as 0.

unlicensed.title: {scheme} data licence pending
unlicensed.body: Classification and membership data are SWS Research data relayed by Tushare; no number is shown until the display terms are confirmed. You can switch to the SIC scheme (US, public SEC data).

adminPreview.title: Internal preview
adminPreview.body: Dataset {dataset} is not public: only admins see these numbers; everyone else sees the licence-pending state.

empty.title: No active run yet
empty.body: The scheme is licensed but has no active aggregate run. The heatmap appears once the first run completes.

reconstruction.title: Reconstruction: these cells are not what was visible at the time
reconstruction.body: Historical periods are rebuilt from membership evidence obtained later: SW membership availability is assumed at the inclusion date (the source has no announcement time) and issuers are resolved by today's ownership. Compare trends, but do not read them as what investors saw then. Each cell becomes available at the run's activation, never back-dated to its period.

partialUnpublished.title: Some dates not published
partialUnpublished.body: Only dates that pass the daily comparison are published; the series breaks at unpublished dates and percentiles use published dates only.

replayMismatch.title: Replay mismatch
replayMismatch.body: The manifest recomputes to a different value than the stored one. The cell is not treated as replayable: the page keeps the stored value with an anomaly badge, and a manifest_mismatch quarantine item is open.

officialUnavailable.title: Official comparison value unavailable
officialUnavailable.body: While the official dataset is not public, only the comparison status is shown, never the official value.

notEnabled.title: Valuation not enabled
notEnabled.body: Self-computed valuations are computed and published only after two basis checks are complete (SW PE/PB basis, total-share basis). Until then no self-computed valuation is shown, and official values are never shown in its place.

noJudgment.title: No judgment registered
noJudgment.body: Lifecycle stage, prosperity and over/under-valuation are judgments, not facts. They appear here only once registered in F4 with a falsifiable condition that can be settled; uncalibrated ones show only their category and a badge.

currentOnly.title: Current value only (current_only)
currentOnly.body: SEC publishes only the current SIC, with no inclusion or exclusion history: the in-date column is the first observation date and dates before it have no members. SIC is not aggregated or valued.

noMembers.title: No known members on this date
noMembers.body: No member is valid on {on} by the evidence known today.

missing.financial_excluded: Excluded by method: no gross margin for financials (financial_excluded)
missing.absent: Row missing from the expected grid

heatmap.label: Heatmap
heatmap.caption: Click a cell for its source drawer; click a name for the industry detail. One brass hue: shade means level, not up or down.
heatmap.mobileNote: Narrow screens show the last 5 periods; see the table for the full series.

table.label: Table view
table.yoyNotStored: No stored YoY for this metric
table.note: YoY shows only the stored YoY metrics (revenue, net income), signed, never red/green: an industry level is not a price move. Coverage = n_with_data / (n_members + n_unresolved); below 0.8 the value cell shows the coverage instead.

detail.notAggregated: v1 aggregates SW level 1 only; this node offers navigation and constituents.
detail.chartLabel: {industry} {metric} series line; values in the table beside it
detail.chartCaption: Any point opens the source drawer (same as the table). Gaps are missing cells, not zeros.
detail.schemeSourceSw: SWS Research, Shenwan Industry Classification Standard (2021), adapted via Tushare index_classify / index_member_all
detail.schemeSourceSic: Current SIC in SEC submissions and the SEC SIC code list
detail.availabilitySw: Members are assumed available on their inclusion date (the source has no announcement time); issuers are resolved by today's ownership
detail.availabilitySic: SIC has current values only; valid_from = first observation date
detail.namesNote: SW publishes no English names: the English UI shows the Chinese name plus the code, without machine translation.

constituents.title: {name} · Constituents
constituents.rule: Date-driven: included on or before the as-of date and not yet excluded, by the evidence known today
constituents.name: Name
constituents.noFact: No published annual fact on this date
constituents.unit: Amounts: CNY in 1e8, USD in billions (raw values in the drawer) · page {page} / {pages}, {size} per page

drawer.title: Source drawer
drawer.reproducedNote: replayFromManifest() recomputes {value} from the manifest alone, equal to the stored value.
drawer.mismatchNote: The manifest recomputes to {replayed}; the stored value is {stored}.
drawer.recomputeMatch: match: a recompute on current evidence equals the recorded manifest.
drawer.recomputeChanged: changed: current evidence differs from the recorded manifest. Late filings, quarantine decisions, mapping upgrades and membership corrections all do this; it is expected.
drawer.diffCounts: members +{ma}/−{mr} · unresolved +{ua}/−{ur} · facts +{fa}/−{fr} · state revisions changed {revs}
drawer.missingCell: A missing cell has no manifest: {reason}
drawer.valuationReplayDeferred: Valuation manifest replay arrives with the valuation pipeline (I-3).
drawer.factEvidence: View the raw fact by fact_id

entry.title: Industry research
entry.desc: SW 2021 · SIC · aggregated industry facts and valuation percentiles

formulas.roe: Σ ttm_net_income_parent / Σ avg(equity_parent the day before the window, at period end)
